description: Main bearded caveman, black hair, yellow tunic with black spots; redrawn in many poses (standing, shrug, laugh, grumpy, fall, sitting, rope, walking thumbs-up, eating, fire warming); line art consistent, each pose a new drawing
Caveman falling with arms raised and grimace, small scale on white; same drawing reused identically for 4 falls (descend to lie flat; pass through; fall into hole; exit hole)
Caveman lying flat face-down after landing; reused identically
Curly-haired caveman with bead necklace, scowling, standing
Caveman kneeling with clasped hands, eyes closed
Caveman with exposed brain on head; poses: steepled smug, finger raised, shrug, sleeping in bed; redrawn per pose
Caveman with wild grey hair and moustache, grin, finger raised
Spiky messy hair caveman, open mouth, gesturing hand outward
Brown leopard-tunic cavemen: waving with 'gruG' name tag, crying close-up, sitting in grass with mushrooms
Caveman with yellow feather headdress; hands on hips, then holding steaming bowl
Caveman in mortarboard pointing at chalkboard
Hunched caveman looking through telescope on mound, lower-right
Police caveman in blue spotted tunic and cap with sunglasses and moustache; wide shot with driver in stone car, then close-up lifting sunglasses
Hairy gorilla-bodied variant of main caveman in same tunic, screaming
White curly-haired figure in leopard dress, back view then grinning face view; also full-frame engraved-style realistic face
Tiny caveman with fists up stomping on rubble
Terrified caveman running left chased by raptor dinosaur
Caveman shaking hands with orange-skinned blond man in white suit
Two cavemen pulling green snake-like rope
Yellow spiky sun; variants: smiling, flexing, realistic serious face, huge muscles screaming, yawning, dead x-eye, ghost fade; each variant a redraw

Round white face with simple eyes: waving small, angry crossed arms, scared palms-out, hungry with fork and knife, enraged, then pac-man style eater holding items, then fat smiling blob; redrawn per pose, stepped zoom-out on scared pose
Outline lightbulb with rays (static, with red X) plus running character-bulb variant
Smug tortoise with lightbulb on shell, and variant with clock on shell
Large hand-drawn red X popped over a drawing to negate it; same overlay reused identically
Black ellipse with white rim representing a regular hole; reused identically in black-on-white and white-on-black (inverted); scribbly textured variant with impact ticks
Hole with outlined rounded bottom/cheeks shape below; same drawing both times
Blue-purple spiral with black centre and black outline; reused identically at various scales and positions (centre, left, upper-left, five-up pattern, with planets)
Black starfield with painted blue spiral galaxy, planets and yellow star; reused identically with different foreground character (caveman, worm)
Black starry sky with white snowy ground used only in opening
Default flat white background used for nearly every segment, with beats of full white blanks between ideas
Full black frame with white hole ellipse
Warm brown parchment texture with sepia cave-painting caveman and 'KRUD GONE SCREAM IF FOUND'; the only non-line-art texture
Bold rounded hand-lettered black capitals, large relative to frame, centred; used for words that match narration: BUT / THEN!, BLACK HOLE., EVENT HORIZON, FOREVER., OUCHY OW OW., GONE.
Same hand-lettered black digits typed on left-aligned one character group at a time: 2, 29, 299, 299,7 ... 299,792,458 with small unit under
Wooden-style signboards with hand-lettered text: 'THIS BLACK HOLE' on mound, 'SPACE QUICKIE QUICKIE' on post; blackboard 'BLACK HOLE'; name tag 'gruG'; wall math '1 + 1 = rock'
Single full-frame realistic cross-hatched face with curly hair, style break from flat cartoon
Moon, ringed planet, earth, saucer planet each with scared face; rotate in strip then turn orange-red
Line-drawn arched cave opening: caveman arms-crossed in doorway; caveman walking in; mound with sign
Orange and yellow flames on white logs with small smoke curl; reused identically in 2 appearances (large centred; small with caveman at end)
Spaghetti bowl, sandwich (McRib-like), steaming soup bowl, stone wheel
Normal clock, warped clock with scrambled glyphs, alarm clock, wristwatch, wall clock held by eater
Four short black tick marks around an object to mark pop or impact
Short black motion lines beside heads, meteor trails, running bulb speed lines
One-off cute side characters: bug waving in grass, goat, worm in hole, ear, clouds, meteor
